calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) as holdout_count
FROM campaign_holdout
WHERE campaign_id = 15

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) as exposed_members
FROM fact_campaign_exposure
WHERE campaign_id = 15

WITH exposed_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT member_key
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure
  WHERE campaign_id = 15
),
exposed_spend AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(f.net_amount), 0) as total_net_spend,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.member_key) as member_count
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-11-24' AND '2025-11-30'
    AND f.member_key IN (SELECT member_key FROM exposed_members)
)
SELECT 
  total_net_spend,
  member_count,
  ROUND(total_net_spend / NULLIF((SELECT mailing_list_size - holdout_size FROM dim_campaign WHERE campaign_id = 15), 0), 2) as avg_spend_per_targeted_member
FROM exposed_spend

WITH holdout_members AS (
  SELECT member_id
  FROM campaign_holdout
  WHERE campaign_id = 15
),
holdout_member_keys AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_key
  FROM dim_member m
  WHERE m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM holdout_members)
    AND m.is_current = TRUE
),
holdout_spend AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(f.net_amount), 0) as total_net_spend,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.member_key) as member_count
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-11-24' AND '2025-11-30'
    AND f.member_key IN (SELECT member_key FROM holdout_member_keys)
)
SELECT 
  total_net_spend,
  member_count,
  ROUND(total_net_spend / NULLIF((SELECT holdout_size FROM dim_campaign WHERE campaign_id = 15), 0), 2) as avg_spend_per_holdout_member
FROM holdout_spend

WITH campaign_info AS (
  SELECT 
    mailing_list_size - holdout_size as targeted_member_count,
    holdout_size as holdout_member_count
  FROM dim_campaign
  WHERE campaign_id = 15
),
holdout_ids AS (
  SELECT member_id
  FROM campaign_holdout
  WHERE campaign_id = 15
),
holdout_keys AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_key
  FROM dim_member m
  WHERE m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM holdout_ids)
    AND m.is_current = TRUE
),
exposed_ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT member_key
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure
  WHERE campaign_id = 15
),
targeted_spend AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(net_amount), 0) as total
  FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2025-11-24' AND '2025-11-30'
    AND member_key IN (SELECT member_key FROM exposed_ids)
),
holdout_spend AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(net_amount), 0) as total
  FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2025-11-24' AND '2025-11-30'
    AND member_key IN (SELECT member_key FROM holdout_keys)
),
calculations AS (
  SELECT 
    ci.targeted_member_count,
    ci.holdout_member_count,
    ts.total as targeted_total,
    hs.total as holdout_total,
    ROUND(ts.total / ci.targeted_member_count, 2) as avg_spend_targeted,
    ROUND(hs.total / ci.holdout_member_count, 2) as avg_spend_holdout
  FROM campaign_info ci,
       targeted_spend ts,
       holdout_spend hs
)
SELECT 
  avg_spend_targeted,
  avg_spend_holdout,
  ROUND(targeted_total - (holdout_member_count * avg_spend_holdout), 2) as uplift_euros
FROM calculations
